storage: fp32 stream with FP4 routed / FP8 shared
full_model.checkpoints: factor-local counters, sparse moments, frozen base binding; native resume/export bit-exact
full_model.scalar_loss: identical-input CE bit-exact; coupled trajectory loss checked against logit Lipschitz plus scalar rounding bound

criterion.step_inputs: every factor and optimizer moment pinned to the frozen reference state, so no gated rounding difference is carried across steps
criterion.native_update: live factor bits must equal the documented pinned single-tensor AdamW policy applied to the native gradient from the pinned state
criterion.fixture_residual: |native - fixture| <= |policy(native gradient) - policy(cpu gradient)| + 8 ulp(max operand magnitude); the response term is computed exactly, not bounded
criterion.amplification: the policy response is additionally bounded by step_size*(1-beta1)*|dgrad|/(|g|+eps)^2 + the operand term

native_residency_identity.checks: initial CPU logits bit-exact; resident/streamed logits, all factor gradients and optimizer factors bit-exact
